## Coaching Note

**Best move: g8=Q**

This is **promotion**—the simplest, most forcing path to victory. Your pawn reached the 7th rank; always push it to promotion immediately rather than moving the king. The new queen dominates Black's pieces, Black has no counterplay, and material (Q+2P vs N+1P) is overwhelmingly in your favor. When a pawn is one square from promoting, that's your move—grab the material and the game ends.
